title: Add Dsl Engine Support to Architect Program
description: Build dsl:: engine (DslDocument/DslRecord/DslScalar/DslEnum derives) DSL-text layer from scratch for architect/program/rs (package architect_program, ~16.6k lines). Program already has vcs::Operation<Program>/OperationDiff (ProgramOperation/ProgramDiff) plus Identified/Patchable/CollectionOperation usage — only the DSL-text layer (derives on Program and its 40+ id-keyed register types, plus ProgramOperation) is missing. No existing DocumentVcsEnvelope needed — framework/plugin/rs's generic VcsDocumentApp<A: DocumentApp> already owns the store for any DocumentApp, which architect-plugin already implements. Confirm foreign-type (mathematical_graph) usage stays test-only. No fixture files exist; correctness proof is round-tripping sample_program()/empty_program() through print_dsl/parse_dsl via vcs::test_support::assert_dsl_round_trip. Verify with cargo test -p architect_program and -p architect-plugin using an isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
summary: Added the dsl:: engine's DSL-text layer to architect_program from scratch. Confirmed the envelope-adoption assumption (architect-plugin's DocumentApp impl bounds Operation: vcs::Operation<Projection>, no OpText requirement, no separate envelope needed) and that mathematical_graph stays test/helper-only (never a Program field type). Added `dsl::DslRecord` to all 75 Program-reachable record types (kernel shared types EntityHeader/Ownership/TextField/TaggedNote/TimestampMeta/QuantitySpec, ProgramMeta/ProjectDefinition/Governance, and all 65 register entity types), `dsl::DslScalar` to all 32 Program-reachable unit-variant enums, and `#[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]` + `#[dsl(extension = "architect", layout = "lines")]` on Program itself — every field on every one of these types classifies through the engine's default Scalar/OptionScalar/VecList/MapField shapes with zero bespoke `#[dsl(...)]` field attributes needed (verified every distinct field-type signature across all registers+patches by script before touching anything). EntityId (a tuple struct) got a hand-written `impl dsl::DslField` (DslRecord only supports named fields). ProgramOperation kept its existing shape (21+ architect-plugin call sites already match on `ProgramOperation::X(CollectionOperation::Y{..})`) and got a hand-written `impl vcs::OpText` (JSON-line encoding) instead of `#[derive(dsl::DslOps)]`, since every collection variant wraps vcs's foreign generic `CollectionOperation<EntityId, T, TPatch>` — the derive's single-field tuple-variant delegation needs `CollectionOperation` itself to implement `dsl::DslField`, which the orphan rule blocks from this crate; documented the rationale inline. Added `dsl = { path = "../../../dsl/rs" }` to Cargo.toml. Extended the existing program/operations test modules (no new test files) with DSL/OpText round-trip coverage: empty_program_dsl_round_trips, sample_program_dsl_round_trips, sample_program_dsl_text_is_parseable_and_reflects_registers, update_meta_op_text_round_trips, add_stakeholder_op_text_round_trips, remove_and_move_op_text_round_trip, set_adjacency_and_clear_adjacency_op_text_round_trip, set_program_op_text_round_trips, op_text_print_op_is_always_one_line. Verified with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-architect-dslgreen-target: `cargo test -p architect_program` → 180 passed, 0 failed (171 pre-existing + 9 new), 0 doctest failures; `cargo test -p architect-plugin` → 11 passed, 0 failed (untouched, confirmed still green). No new compiler warnings introduced in architect_program. architect/plugin/rs/lib.rs shows as modified in git status but that 1-line change (icon name) pre-existed/was staged before this session started — not touched by this ticket.
